title: Santa Catarina Albarradas Zapotec

titles.display: Santa Catarina Albarradas Zapotec

extract: Santa Catarina Albarradas Zapotec, also known as San Antonio Albarradas Zapotec, is a Zapotec language of Oaxaca, Mexico. Speakers find neighboring Santo Domingo Albarradas Zapotec marginally intelligible (80%), but the reverse is not the case (50%).
